notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through an installed OS-visible VSN virtual microphone. The verified Windows foundation includes Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, deterministic device selection/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 planning, event-driven WASAPI capture, sample decode/reframing, CaptureRuntime reopen recovery, IMMNotificationClient delivery, bounded virtual-mic staging/output, Rust/C++ transport ABI, aligned Interlocked cursor publication, deterministic shared-region geometry, real user-mode section mapping and a WDK-buildable KMDF control driver with a secure driver-owned section lifecycle. The caller-supplied-section CONNECT assumption was replaced by driver-owned CONNECT v2 in merge 3953069f468c46d744f30625b3696e5b12f03a77. The KMDF control-driver slice merged as b2761ad400d92c1d810751fabcf4b071a40dfb9c. Protocol v2 then added an aligned per-slot seqlock stamp and guarded ConsumeOneRingFrame; AI Native run 34541120876 and Windows run 34541120903 passed before merge 9c57207482bdc20ca5dc70a06cbb43c0cfa86741. The PortCls/WaveRT descriptor slice established a build-valid 48 kHz mono 32-bit IEEE-float single-capture-stream descriptor set; AI Native run 34542011551 and Windows run 34542011553 passed before merge da1b0543bcbfe63ff6a342690cab3b250057bbe2. The PortCls lifecycle/WaveRT stream-contract slice added compile/link references to PcInitializeAdapterDriver and PcAddAdapterDevice while keeping StartDevice fail-closed with STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED; AI Native run 34543128712 and Windows run 34543128651 passed before merge 78ef04bf86bf02b25b9da25ef401dc84f73f0f2b. The subsequent named WDF control-device scaffold used WdfControlDeviceInitAllocate with SYSTEM + built-in Administrators SDDL, exclusive buffered I/O, a sequential passive-level queue and fail-closed IOCTL dispatch; AI Native run 34543962499 and Windows run 34543962515 passed before merge f084e4be4d7930830ca68948699c26e42fc036c1. A follow-up migration branch reused the secure CONNECT/DISCONNECT/QUERY_STATUS runtime from that WDF control-device factory, but it was closed unmerged as superseded in PR #18 after Microsoft KMDF miniport guidance was re-checked. Microsoft explicitly requires WdfDriverInitNoDispatchOverride for KMDF miniports and states that miniport drivers cannot use framework control-device objects. Therefore the merged WDF control-device scaffold is retained only as compile-verified experimental evidence and is not a valid live PortCls control-plane design. Microsoft PortCls documentation separately states that PcInitializeAdapterDriver installs IRP handlers, that an adapter driver may overwrite selected handlers, and that custom handlers can forward non-owned IRPs back to PortCls via PcDispatchIrp. Microsoft named-device guidance requires IoCreateDeviceSecure for a named control device when security is not supplied by INF and recommends a unique class GUID plus FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN. The supported next WU-002 architecture is therefore a same-driver raw WDM control device owned by the PortCls adapter driver: create a secure named control DO with IoCreateDeviceSecure, keep the existing driver-owned shared-section/session state in the same driver, replace only CREATE/CLOSE/CLEANUP/DEVICE_CONTROL dispatch entries needed for that control DO, discriminate on the exact control PDEVICE_OBJECT, and forward every non-control device IRP to PortCls with PcDispatchIrp. This avoids both the prohibited WDF control-device path and an unnecessary cross-driver kernel bridge. The first implementation slice must be compile/fail-closed only: secure WDM control-device creation/teardown, unique class GUID, dispatch discrimination and forwarding contract, without exposing the CONNECT ABI until the existing verified ownership/section lifecycle has been safely ported from WDFREQUEST/WDFFILEOBJECT semantics to IRP/PFILE_OBJECT semantics. After that boundary is CI verified, port CONNECT/DISCONNECT/QUERY_STATUS and cleanup semantics to the WDM control DO, then switch live DriverEntry to PortCls primary ownership while StartDevice remains fail-closed. Actual wave/topology miniports, WaveRT stream scheduling bound to ConsumeOneRingFrame, INF/install/test-signing, endpoint enumeration, calling-app routing and controlled-hardware evidence remain pending. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
